governance.note: This run's purpose was to remove the one NEISO lever that violated the measured-input rule: the daily Algonquin Citygate (AGT) gas-basis was previously reconstructed by redistributing the measured monthly basis across a month's days proportional to NEISO demand raised to AGT_DAILY_BASIS_CONVEXITY=7.0, with the exponent CHOSEN so the resulting gas->oil switching tracked the measured EIA-930 oil burn (a within-month shape fitted to the electricity/oil residual). That proxy and its _neiso_daily_demand driver are retired. The daily AGT basis is now built entirely from real measured gas-market data: the real Algonquin Citygate daily spot prints EIA publishes in the prose of every Natural Gas Weekly Update (data/raw/gas-prices/algonquin_citygate_daily.csv, scripts/fetch_algonquin_daily_spot.py; 123 dated prints 2023-2025), interpolated on their true calendar days and mean-preserved to the measured monthly AGT basis; sparse-print months borrow the measured Transco Z6 NY daily-basis within-month shape (AGT~=Transco basis, measured slope ~0.95, corr ~0.79), capped at AGT's own measured price ceiling. All other levers remain measured: historic CAMPD unit-level outage windows (exogenous availability), EIA-860 cogen BTM CHP host-steam pulled out of the LP, measured F923 per-plant monthly delivered gas under the measured EIA monthly AGT hub-basis overlay, measured EIA-930 net interchange, measured EIA-860 dual-fuel switching at the delivered oil price. No adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to the price or volume residual; no unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled so model output lands on actuals. Mean-preserving by construction (the daily series' monthly mean equals the measured monthly basis), so the annual gas burn and fuel mix are unchanged vs the monthly overlay.
governance.validation_note: Gas-vs-gas (no electricity) validation: the reconstructed daily AGT tracks the held real AGT prints at MAE $0.71/$0.74/$2.08 (corr 0.98/0.96/0.65) for 2023/24/25. Mechanism effect vs the monthly-basis control on current code: winter LMP hours >$200/MWh 0/0/80 -> 55/20/191 (measured ~44/11/160); oil burn 0.00/0.00/0.16 -> 0.28/0.20/1.66 TWh (actual EIA-930 0.32/0.37/1.24); pumped-storage discharge 0.24/0.31/1.08 -> 0.36/0.49/1.14 TWh; system mean LMP preserved (74.9 -> 74.2, 2025).

exceptions.reason: The real daily AGT spot now reaches ~$27-36/MMBtu on the coldest days, but every gas tranche flagged dual-fuel by EIA-860 is capped at the delivered oil price (~$18/MMBtu), so the cleared LMP tops out near the oil-peaker cost (~$293/MWh) and never exceeds $300. The >$300 scarcity hours in the real market come from single-fuel gas bidding the full AGT spot and from ORDC/reserve scarcity pricing, neither fully represented. This is an open structural item for a follow-up (single-fuel gas offer at AGT spot; reserve scarcity), NOT addressed or maskable by the daily-AGT input, and explicitly NOT to be closed by re-tuning the gas input to the residual.
